title: Story premise EDU115: The Screw Unrolls Into a Ramp
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (practical mechanisms). Hook: How far does one complete turn move this thread? Takeaway/theme: For an ideal single-start screw, one full turn advances by its pitch.
description: A sketch artist wants to explain why a screw advances as it turns, but the helix hides its repeating rise. Unrolling an idealized thread onto a flat diagram reveals the pitch and its connection to axial travel.
